collection.description: An elder in pain begs for a pearl from an endangered mollusk said to ease pain.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A pearl from an endangered mollusk is rumored to relieve pain when worn. An elder begs for it.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The elder receives attention and treatment without destroying the mollusk.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The diver documents its beauty but cannot test the claim.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The pearl is obtained at ecological cost; any relief may be belief, chance, or something unexplained.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: A family lends an heirloom; the elder appreciates the gesture.
